title: Footwork Fundamentals - 2 Weeks
description: Master the foundation of JKD movement with this focused footwork program. Build balance, agility, and fighting mobility from the ground up.

days.notes: The cornerstone of JKD footwork. Focus on keeping weight on the back leg, staying light.
Add punching to your footwork. Move, then strike. Don't sacrifice balance for speed.
Reverse pattern. Essential for retreating while maintaining guard and balance.
Rest day. Your legs may be sore - that's good! Tomorrow we add explosiveness.
Explosive forward movement. Learn to close distance quickly while maintaining structure.
Combine all three patterns. Flow between them naturally based on distance and intention.
Rhythmic footwork. Develop timing and ability to change direction instantly.
Week 1 complete! Rest and prepare for advanced footwork patterns in week 2.
Weight shifting mastery. This footwork creates angles and evades attacks.
Angle creation with striking. Move offline, then attack from superior position.
Integration day. Practice transitioning smoothly between all footwork patterns.
Explosive entry with kicks. Close distance and attack in one motion.
Advanced patterns with longer combinations. Your footwork should feel natural now.
Final day - all footwork patterns. Congratulations on mastering JKD movement fundamentals!
